final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT o.ordertune AS ot, COUNT(*) AS c FROM riskandmargin r JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = r.ordervault GROUP BY o.ordertune), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(c) AS a FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.ot AS ot, s1.c AS c, s1.c - s2.a AS d FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.a IS NOT NULL WHERE s1.c > s2.a) SELECT AVG(c), AVG(d) FROM s3
